data.title: Contribution Notice (Beitragsbescheid) – IKK Nordmuster
data.case_title: IKK Nordmuster – New Health and Long-Term Care Insurance Contribution
data.summary: IKK Nordmuster has recalculated Laura Beispielwinkel's voluntary health and long-term care insurance contributions based on the 2026 income tax assessment, setting the monthly contribution at €451.54 effective 1 November 2027.
data.explanation: Your health insurer (IKK Nordmuster) recalculated your voluntary health and long-term care insurance contribution based on your 2026 income tax assessment. From 1 November 2027 the monthly amount will be €451.54, debited automatically from your account on the 15th of the following month as before. If you disagree with this calculation, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at IKK Nordmuster; the app shows until when you can still do so. If you do nothing, the new contribution amount becomes binding and will keep being debited automatically.
data.tax_note: Voluntary health and long-term care insurance contributions are generally deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in the income tax return, so keep this notice for that purpose.

remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen die Beitragsfestsetzung ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich; Sie können ihn schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der IKK Nordmuster, Innungsplatz 7, 24539 Musterneumünster, einlegen.
